project_type: Vite SPA with Three.js 3D globe, GSAP animations, and multi-page species profiles
build_system: Vite 8 - standard npm build, no special quirks
test_command: npm run build (no tests exist - build success is the verification)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build and verify no errors. Check dist/ output includes all HTML pages and assets.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/data/*.json files are generated by scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js but can also be manually edited. dist/ is the build output (gitignored).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js v22 pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Deploy is via GitHub Pages on push to main. Current work is on feat/immersive-redesign branch.
key_patterns: Species data in public/data/*.json, species HTML pages in species/*.html all share same template structure with data-species attribute on body. src/species-page.js dynamically renders content from JSON. Main page uses Three.js canvas with overlay sections driven by scroll progress. GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-based animations.
directory_structure: Root: index.html + vite.config.js + package.json. src/: main.js (entry), style.css (main page styles), cinematic-engine.js (Three.js scene + postprocessing), globe.js (3D globe with data columns), overlay-ui.js (scroll-driven overlay visibility), species-page.js + species-page.css (species detail pages). species/: 10 HTML files (one per species). public/data/: 10 JSON files with species data. scripts/: fetch-tmdb-data.js (TMDB data pipeline).
